decision_rule_result.decision: Keep 30B-A3B MoE as the served vision model, retain the FIT-164 scale-cue prompt, and do not switch to 32B dense in this PR.
rationale: 30B-A3B was not within 15% of 32B by macro MAPE, but both models exceeded the 25% macro-MAPE threshold.
The runbook therefore called for adding a scale-cue prompt instead of switching again.
32B dense reduced macro MAPE but averaged 23.20s versus 2.75s for the 30B baseline and 3.10s after the scale-cue prompt.

The post-scale 30B rerun stayed 50/50 schema-valid but only improved aggregate MAPE from 37.33% to 35.82%; further accuracy work should target portion/gold-metric weaknesses rather than a model swap alone.

notes: Raw PNG fixtures and the local image map stayed outside the repository and are intentionally excluded from Git.
The eval uses macro MAPE with denominator max(abs(gold), 1), so very low or zero-carb foods can create large percentage outliers.
eval_set.source: local synthetic gold-standard food-photo eval set
